description: This file contains implementation of FP-Growth and PrefixSpan algorithms for mining frequent itemsets and sequential patterns in PySpark's MLlib library. It defines classes, methods, and functions related to these algorithms, including model loading, training, and sequence mining.

classes.name: FPGrowthModel
classes.description: A FP-Growth model for mining frequent itemsets using the Parallel FP-Growth algorithm.

classes.name: FPGrowth
classes.description: A parallel FP-growth algorithm to mine frequent itemsets.

classes.name: PrefixSpanModel
classes.description: Model fitted by PrefixSpan for mining sequential patterns.

classes.name: PrefixSpan
classes.description: A parallel PrefixSpan algorithm to mine frequent sequential patterns.

methods.name: freqItemsets
methods.description: Returns the frequent itemsets of this FP-Growth model.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads an FP-Growth model from the specified path.

methods.name: train
methods.description: Computes an FP-Growth model that contains frequent itemsets.

methods.name: freqSequences
methods.description: Gets frequent sequences from a PrefixSpan model.

methods.name: train
methods.description: Finds the complete set of frequent sequential patterns in the input sequences.
